author: @sunilmehta-si

evidence.api_compatibility: The span attribute key llm.vllm.gpu_cache_usage_factor is unchanged; its source metric changes from the nonexistent vllm:gpu_cache_usage_factor to vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc (a 0-1 fraction). The span keys llm.vllm.cpu_cache_usage_factor and llm.vllm.num_requests_swapped are being dropped — they only existed in the V0 engine and no vLLM release exports them anyway, so existing setups will not break but will continue to see them absent.
evidence.documentation: docs/guide/configuration/README.md was updated to reflect the corrected metric names (vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc mapping, removal of cpu_cache_usage_factor and num_requests_swapped from the documented vLLM span attributes).
evidence.manual_release_testing: No human exercised this against a live vLLM backend. The telemetry span attributes llm.vllm.gpu_cache_usage_factor, llm.vllm.num_requests_waiting, and llm.vllm.num_requests_running are user-visible via the tracing/telemetry system, so manual verification with a running vLLM instance is needed before release.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after the first and latest approval at 2026-11-25T18:27:56Z. The branch tip at merge time (87fde11fe04b708a803707ff854402f38e263223) is the same commit that was approved, with no post-approval churn.
evidence.review: PR #4239 received one approval from @fl0rianr ('Thanks, very nice!'). Per docs/dev/contribute.md, @fl0rianr's subject areas are LMX omni models, GUI, CI, and smart router — not vLLM. The vLLM subject-matter maintainers are @ramkrishna2910 and @sawansri, neither of whom reviewed. No inline comments were filed. The change is small and well-scoped, but the lack of domain expertise in the review is a quality gap.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change only affects how prometheus-style text is parsed for metrics.
evidence.tests: Unit tests in test/cpp/test_telemetry_helpers.cpp comprehensively cover three scenarios: gauges without labels, labeled gauges in the order vLLM 0.20 emits them (including the waiting_by_reason prefix fix), and malformed input. All 122 tests pass. The author did not run against a live vLLM backend (no AMD GPU).

maintainer_todos.text: Start Lemonade with a vLLM backend and run a generation request; confirm the trace span includes llm.vllm.gpu_cache_usage_factor with a value in the 0-1 range and llm.vllm.num_requests_waiting is present, and that no cpu_cache_usage_factor or num_requests_swapped keys appear.

subject: fix(vllm): read the KV cache and waiting metrics vLLM exports (#4239)
summary: Fixes the vLLM telemetry metrics parser to read the actual metrics exported by vLLM 0.19/0.20 (maps vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc to the existing llm.vllm.gpu_cache_usage_factor span attribute, drops V0-only metrics cpu_cache_usage_factor and num_requests_swapped, and matches whole metric names to prevent vllm:num_requests_waiting_by_reason from overwriting vllm:num_requests_waiting) and updates the vLLM backend version pins in backend_versions.json.
verdict_reason: No vLLM-subject-matter reviewer approved the PR and the telemetry behavior changes were not exercised against a live vLLM backend before merge.
